question: Which Indian cricket player got the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virat Kohli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2018**, Indian cricketer **Virat Kohli** received the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**.
 
• The award is India's **highest sporting honor**.
 
• The award includes a medal, certificate, and a cash prize of ₹25 lakh.
 
• **Other recipient in 2018**: **Mirabai Chanu** for Weightlifting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award (RGKR)** is India's **highest sporting honor**.
 
• **Established**: In **1991–92**, named after **Rajiv Gandhi**, India's 6th Prime Minister.
 
• **Renamed in 2021**: Now called the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, after the legendary Indian field hockey player.
 
• **First recipient**: Chess Grandmaster **Viswanathan Anand**.
 
• **Youngest recipient**: **Abhinav Bindra** at age 18.
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in 2023 was awarded to **Chirag Chandrashekhar Shetty** and **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy**, both in the discipline of **Badminton**. 
 
• Athletes are evaluated based on their performances over the preceding **four years** in major international competitions.
 
• The award recognizes athletes for their **outstanding performances** at the **international level**, including events like the Olympics, World Championships, and other prestigious international tournaments.
 
• Nominations for the award are made by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, based on recommendations from the selection committee.
